categories.decision: The platform-admin aggregate is represented through its domain routers; no generic super-admin agent tool is permitted.
Expose bounded reads, questions, delegation, outcomes, and governed evaluation requests while keeping identity and model rollout privileged.
CRM agents may read and draft but never approve/send; billing agents may read and propose but never mutate Stripe or access.
Agents receive permission-aware account and institutional-memory reads; human admins govern authoritative decisions, priorities, promotion, and supersession.
A separately authenticated platform worker may read exact current founder decisions only; credential lifecycle and every mutation remain human platform-admin controlled.
Expose safe reads and reviewable drafts; publication, deployment application, and broad mutation remain approval-bound.
Readiness and job state are agent-readable; upload quarantine, malware, and review transitions retain canonical human/system gates.
Agents may inspect support state and create approved drafts; participant, resolution, and attachment boundaries remain canonical.
Client identity and venue state are readable; account lifecycle mutations remain privileged and auditable.
Expose bounded operational intelligence and drafts; provider execution, incident control, and publication stay gated.
Session metadata is privacy-bounded; raw replay and simulation require a separate synthetic developer contract.
Agents may inspect safe state but cannot issue credentials or change entitlements autonomously.
Finalization is high consequence; agents may gain preview/read support but not autonomous finalization.
